What is the Personalized Study Plan System?
answer: The Personalized Study Plan System is a Flask-based web application that assists students and administrators in course recommendations, weekly study planning, administrative management, and providing chatbot support for course-related queries.

question: What are the system requirements for using the application?
answer: The system requires a web browser (latest version of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Safari) and internet access.

question: How do I access the application?
answer: To access the application, visit the web URL: https://personalizedstudyplan.onrender.com. On the landing page, you will see options for Student Login, Create Account, or Admin Login.

question: How do I register as a student?
answer: On the landing page, click 'Create Account,' then fill in your Student ID, Name, Email, and Password. Optionally, upload a profile picture. Click 'Register' to complete the process.

question: How do I log in as a student?
answer: On the landing page, click 'Student Login.' Enter your Student ID and Password, then click 'Login.' You will be redirected to the Home Page upon successful login.

question: What features are available on the Student Home Page?
answer: The Home Page includes announcements, current semester details, an upcoming exam section, and navigation links to Course Recommendations, Study Planner, Chatbot Support, and more.

question: How do I use the Course Recommendation feature?
answer: Go to the Course Recommendation page from the sidebar. Select your School, Programme, Year, and Semester, then click 'Next.' Mark any prerequisites you have completed and click 'Get Recommendations' to view eligible courses.

question: How do I use the Weekly Study Planner?
answer: Access the Study Planner from the sidebar. Click '+Add New Task' to create a task by selecting the day, start/end time, and task description. You can edit or delete tasks later.

question: How do I interact with the chatbot?
answer: Go to Chatbot Support from the sidebar or visit /chatbot. Type your query into the message box and press Send. The chatbot will respond with relevant information.

question: What should I do if the chatbot says it doesn't know the answer?
answer: If the chatbot doesn't know the answer, it will say, 'Can you teach me?' Only admins can provide new answers by logging in and using the teaching mode feature.

question: How do I reset my password as a student?
answer: On the Student Login page, click 'Forgot Password?' Enter your email address and check your inbox for a password reset link. Use the link to set a new password.

question: How do I log out as a student?
answer: Click 'Logout' in the navigation bar or near your profile link. This will return you to the landing page.

question: How do I log in as an admin?
answer: On the landing page, click 'Admin Login' or access /admin/login. Enter your username and password to log in.

question: What features are available on the Admin Dashboard?
answer: The Admin Dashboard includes options to manage Schools, Programmes, Terms, Semesters, Courses, Announcements, and Semester Information.

question: How do I manage schools as an admin?
answer: Go to /admin/manage_schools. Add a new school by providing its name and description. You can also edit or delete existing schools.

question: How do I manage programmes as an admin?
answer: Visit /admin/manage_programmes. Add a programme by providing its name, selecting the school, and entering a description. You can also edit or delete programmes.

question: How do I manage terms and semesters as an admin?
answer: For terms, go to /admin/manage_terms to add or edit academic years. For semesters, go to /admin/manage_semesters to associate terms with semesters and provide descriptions.

question: How do I manage courses as an admin?
answer: Visit /admin/manage_courses to add, edit, or delete courses. Provide details such as Course Code, Name, Credit Hours, Programme, Semester, and any prerequisites.

question: How do I add announcements as an admin?
answer: Go to /admin/announcements. Add a new announcement by providing a title and message. Announcements can also be deleted if no longer needed.

question: How do I update semester information as an admin?
answer: Go to /admin/semesterinfo. Update the semester's name, start/end dates, and exam dates. Set 'Is_Current=1' to activate the semester.

question: How do I teach the chatbot new answers as an admin?
answer: If the chatbot says, 'I donâ€™t know the answer,' log in as admin and access the teaching mode at /teach. Provide the question and answer in JSON format to update the knowledge base.

question: What should I do if I cannot log in?
answer: Ensure your username/password or Student ID/password is correct. Use the 'Forgot Password' feature for students or consult an admin for admin credentials.

question: Why are there no announcements displayed?
answer: The admin may not have added any announcements, or the announcements table in the database is empty.

question: What should I do if the chatbot doesnâ€™t recognize my query?
answer: The question may not exist in the knowledge base. Contact an admin to add the answer using the chatbot's teaching mode.
